name: tau-canonical-ots
instr:
The repository at `/workdir` is Tau, a small Python coding-agent harness split into three packages under `src/`:
`tau_ai` (provider-neutral model streaming), `tau_agent` (the portable agent loop, tools, events and session
primitives) and `tau_coding` (the coding application: built-in file and shell tools, skills, prompt templates,
project instructions, project trust and context accounting).

Fix all implementation drift from the documentation in this repository.
Everything in scope is these Python modules: every module in src/tau_agent/ and in src/tau_agent/session/; src/tau_ai/__init__.py, _provider_events.py, content.py, env.py, events.py, fake.py, http.py, http_errors.py, model_limits.py, openai_cache.py, provider.py, retry.py, stream.py and tool_call_ids.py; and src/tau_coding/context.py, context_window.py, events.py, image_processing.py, paths.py, project_trust.py, prompt_templates.py, provider_catalog.py, resources.py, self_docs.py, session_manager.py, session_stats.py, shell_config.py, skills.py, system_prompt.py, thinking.py and tools.py. Together with them, the website pages website/content/concepts.md; website/content/internals/agent-loop.md, architecture.md and design-principles.md; website/content/guides/project-instructions.md, project-trust.md and skills-and-prompts.md; website/content/reference/tools.md; and the module, class and function docstrings of the in-scope modules.

Where the code and the documentation disagree about runtime behavior, the documentation
